sentences.en: My taking the book is justified by my seeing it.
sentences.zh: 我拿这本书是有理由的。

sentences.en: The conditions were deemed sufficiently unsafe to justify an evacuation.
sentences.zh: 由于条件被认为足够不安全，因此进行了撤离。

sentences.en: As the proverb goes, "The end justifies the means."
sentences.zh: 正如谚语所说，“手段正当即可。”
